endpointOrParams: Genuine JSON REST API at /api/SRC/*, driven via plain HTTP GET/POST (no browser/JS execution) -- this session fully solved the previously-unreverse-engineered POST /api/SRC/quote endpoint; full recipe documented in CALCULATORS.md. Sequence: GET /api/SRC/transactiontypes?statecode=WV -> GET /api/SRC/propertysearch?value=Charleston,%20WV (resolves Kanawha County, CountyFIPS 54039, zip 25301) -> GET /api/SRC/policycoveragetypes (OP and MP legs, both BASIC) -> GET /api/SRC/providers?statecode=WV&countycode=54039&zipcode=25301&transactiontype=SALE (returns the only settlement office serving this county, Omnia Title Corp., ID 3030) -> GET /api/SRC/statesettings?statecode=WV -> GET /api/SRC/ernstlookup?statecode=WV&countycode=54039 -> two POST /api/SRC/quote calls (QuoteType=2 Netsheet flow for recording/transfer-tax, QuoteType=3 Fee-Estimate flow with ProviderID=3030 for the itemized settlement fee), each with a QuoteRequestRoot JSON body and a scraped antiforgery token/cookie pair. No personal-data fields required or entered.
scenario: $500,000 purchase price / $400,000 loan amount, Kanawha County (Charleston), residential resale, Sale/Purchase with Mortgage transaction.
methodology: First session to complete reverse-engineering of Stewart's /api/SRC/quote endpoint (flagged unreverse-engineered since 2026-07-22/23) -- confirmed working nationwide, not WV-specific. Full request/response detail and step-by-step recipe in CALCULATORS.md's 2026-08-14 Stewart Title entry.
